---
title: "Handbook on utilising new data sources in the production of consumer price statistics"
---

::: {.callout-note title="Migration in progress"}
This site is a migration of the UN Task Team
[handbook](https://unstats.un.org/wiki/spaces/GWGSD/pages/240910447/Handbook+on+utilising+new+data+sources+in+the+production+of+consumer+price+statistics)
from the UN Statistics Confluence wiki to Quarto, so the handbook can be
version-controlled and maintained on GitHub. All pages have been converted with
automated tooling; review and sign-off by the Task Team is ongoing.
:::

Start with the [introduction](introduction.qmd), or browse the full handbook
from the sidebar.

Rendering fidelity was validated first on the most demanding pages:

- [Extension methods](extension-methods.qmd) — figures and LaTeX formulas together
- [Multilateral price index methods](multilateral-price-index-methods.qmd) — the
  handbook's most formula-dense page
- [How to evaluate classification methods](how-to-evaluate-classification-methods.qmd)

Conversion tooling and migration status live in the repo (`MIGRATION.md`,
`scripts/convert_page.py`, `scripts/convert_all.py`).
